name: Phosphetane-catalysed deoxygenation of nitrobenzene: 18O KIEs, monotopic transition structure TS1B

reference.citation: B. Kang, A. T. Radosevich, Tetrahedron 2025, 186, 134892
reference.method: 18O KIEs by intermolecular competition of [15N]-, [15N,18O1]- and [15N,18O2]-nitrobenzene (51.1% 18O) in the PIII/PV=O-catalysed reductive N-arylation with PhB(OH)2 (15 mol% 1,2,2,3,4,4-hexamethylphosphetane 1-oxide, PhSiH3, CPME, 120 C); GC-MS of the recovered nitrobenzene at 0 and 5 h (F_T 0.83-0.87), three runs; values from Tables 1 and 2. Structures from SI section III.B (M06-2X/6-31G(d,p), gas phase, ORCA 6.0.1); the authors' PyQuiver predictions (393 K, scaled 0.9614) from Table 3 and SI Tables S2 and S3

notes: TS1B is the monotopic frontside transition structure the paper rejects (50.4 kcal/mol, against 33.4 for TS2): phosphorus attacks one oxygen (O2 here, P-O 2.223 A) and not the other (O3, 2.727 A). The two positions give very different KIEs: 1.0474 for the attacked oxygen and 1.0140 for the spectator (uncorrected). The paper's 1.0468 for one 18O is the attacked position alone. A singly labelled substrate reacts through both isotopomers, so its KIE is 2/(1/KIE_attacked + 1/KIE_spectator) = 1.0304 (1.0319 with Bell tunnelling), within the measured 1.033 +/- 0.003; the runner takes the geometric mean, 1.0305 (Phase 10 makes it exact). The doubly labelled KIE, 1.0621 (1.0654 with Bell), is also within about 1.3 standard errors of 1.066, and it is close to the square of the singly labelled one, so TS1B scales multiplicatively too. The 18O KIEs therefore do not distinguish TS1B from TS2 once the singly labelled value is averaged over both oxygens; TS1B is excluded by its energy. Every isotopologue carries 15N, so each KIE is relative to [15N]-nitrobenzene (the reference label). The two nitro oxygens are equivalent in nitrobenzene, so the singly labelled substrate reacts through both transition-structure isotopomers and its KIE is averaged over the two positions (iso_average). The paper converts conversion and isotope ratios into KIEs with the exact competition equation of Bigeleisen and Wolfsberg (eq S38 of Dale, Leach, Lloyd-Jones, JACS 2021, 143, 21079); from their Tables 1 and 2 all six run values reproduce to the digits printed. Treating the three isotopologues in the flask together, rather than each labelled one against [15N]-1 alone, moves the mean singly labelled KIE by -0.0004 and the doubly labelled one by less than 0.0001, well inside the stated +/- 0.003. The experiments ran at 120 +/- 2 C; 393 K is the temperature of the authors' predictions. Structures: ORCA 6.1.0 frequency jobs (M06-2X/6-31G(d,p)) at the SI geometries, in benchmarks/nitroarene_phosphetane (nitrobenzene: N 12, O 13 and 14). The geometries are not exactly stationary at this ORCA version, so external modes are projected out, as ORCA does for the frequencies it prints; that changes the KIEs by less than 4e-6. In TS1B the nitrogen is atom 1 and the oxygens 2 (attacked) and 3.
level_of_theory: M06-2X/6-31G(d,p), gas phase (ORCA 6.0.1), scaled 0.9614 as in the paper

kies.note: PyQuiver 1.0468 for the attacked oxygen alone (Wigner 1.0495, inverted parabola 1.0498)
